Latest ground report from Package-01 of the *Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor* in Andhra Pradesh.
In this video, we take a detailed look at the current construction progress of Package-01, including the *Odisha–Andhra Pradesh border section,* major viaducts, completed roadway stretches, lane markings, Wayside Amenities (WSA), & the impressive Mathumuru Interchange (Exit-18).
